authority: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-30-tfrl-three-way-comparison-and-improvement-plan.md sections 2 (M1, M2), 4, 9, 10 (rulings 3 and 4), 11 and 12; the machinery of scripts/analysis/slurp_l338_port_column_read.py (paired_ci.py: row-paired utterance-cluster bootstrap, replicate-widened CI95, per-row F1, the NOMINATED rule)

bank_release.t0_rule: T0, the official SLURP test split, is never a source of the exemplar bank or the rule bank (comparison plan 2026-10-30, section on the evaluation tiers: 'T0 rows are never exemplar or bank sources'). No T0 roster is registered in this repository; the rule is therefore structural: the only admitted bank sources are the two construction halves R01C-H1 and R01C-H2 by roster id AND pinned split identity, and the flight-start refusal (rails.tfrl_v2_consumption.verify_bank) names any other source, so a T0 row cannot enter a bank even if a T0 roster is registered later.

claim_boundary: No benefit, system-level, superiority, generalisation, held-out, confirmatory or paper-scale claim. Development numbers only.

construction_gain.definition: SLU-F1(vote) - SLU-F1(lock) over the usable rows of BOTH halves of the iteration, in pp, pooled; vote = scenario_action by plurality over s1..s4 (tie: the lowest k), entities kept at support >= 2 of 4 (plan section 12; README acceptance rule). The vote answers are derived model-free from the trace by the reader's `vote` stage; the official scorer scores that derived copy as column `vote`; the reader never scores
construction_gain.never_from: the loop adapter (plan section 11 addendum ruling 6)
construction_gain.unscored_vote: when the `vote` column is not scored the gain is null and the stop word is UNDETERMINED, never a pass

construction_read.credit: reward(k) = official per-row SLU-F1 of trajectory s_k minus that of lock (tfrl_v2_sampler.credit_rows); a row is POSITIVE when its best intent-correct trajectory beats lock by more than 0 and lock and aa agree on the row

per_half.exemplar_coverage_per_scenario: for each scenario stratum of the half's roster: rows, exemplars in the union bank, covered = at least one exemplar; plus the covered share of scenarios and of rows
per_half.mean_best_of_k_gain_pp: 100 x mean over usable rows of max over k of reward(k) (negative values included; the oracle best-of-K, reported beside the positive rate)
per_half.positive_rate: positives / usable rows of the half (a usable row has all K Solver trajectories, lock and aa scored)
per_half.rule_survivors: rules in the half's bank (rule-bank.json of the bank distilled from the half; survivors of the 3-row vote) and, for the iteration, in the union bank

construction_read.unit: one iteration, both halves, from the sealed trace of each half's construction flight (contact and score lines) and the iteration's bank receipts

contacts.scorer: CPU official scorer jobs over derived copies only (the vote column)

accepted_only_if: twin admissible: |SLU-F1(aa) - SLU-F1(lock)| <= 1.2 pp (rounded to 6 decimals)
the construction gain of the iteration >= +1.0 pp
fold_b_read.columns: arm-<arm>-<scorer>-scores.json written by stage3_rollout_score --mode perception-branches (official scorer, per-row counts)
fold_b_read.confirmed_only_if: the Fold A flight of the accepted state has a widened CI95 lower bound of t-v2 - lock above 0 (M2); the optimism term is reported always (read by the Fold A reader, not here)

noise_model.formula: V_rep = mean over the pairwise deltas of D**2; SE_b = (hi - lo) / (2 z); SE_t = sqrt(SE_b**2 + V_rep); widening w = z (SE_t - SE_b); reported CI95 = [lo - w, hi + w]; z = 1.959964
noise_model.words: the CI95 of every arm delta is the row-paired bootstrap interval widened by the replicate variance of {lock, aa, lock-rep2}; the point estimate is unchanged

fold_b_read.nominated_rule: NOMINATED when the pooled SLU-F1 delta has point >= the SLU floor AND widened CI95 lower bound > 0, the per-row SLU-F1 delta has widened CI95 lower bound > 0, no resolved per-row loss (per-row CI95 upper bound >= -SLU floor), the intent guard holds (intent CI95 lower bound >= -intent floor and intent point >= 0); HARM when a pooled upper bound is below minus its floor; otherwise NEUTRAL (plan section 10 ruling 4; the per-row F1 is a repo diagnostic, never an official SLURP number)
fold_b_read.unit: the iteration's Fold B selection flight: the bank-consuming arms minus lock, paired per row inside the flight

stop_rule.text: the loop continues only while the construction-column gain of the iteration is >= +1.0 pp (compared after rounding to 6 decimals, so +1.000000 passes and +0.9 stops), at most 3 iterations, and an iteration that accepts nothing stops; a gain under +1.0 pp at iteration 1 stops the family

what_is_not_here: no model, server or tokenizer contact; the vote column is scored by the official scorer on a derived copy outside the reader
no admission, no readiness flip, no ledger row
Fold A confirmation (a separate package and reader)
